experiment_data.hypothesis: Statistical features (19-dimensional: perplexity stats, surprisal, n-gram entropy, repetition ratios) can predict generation depth (0-3) with over 70% accuracy using learned classifiers (ordinal MLP, prototypical networks, XGBoost), and this generalizes across models in leave-one-out evaluation, because recursive generation progressively degrades text quality in statistically measurable ways.
experiment_data.notes: plan_025. CORRECTED: XGBoost mean 66.1%, Ordinal MLP 63.2%, Prototypical ~65.4% (gpt2xl NaN). All three learned classifiers FAIL to beat RF baseline 66.4%. Confirms 19-feature bottleneck: switching classifier cannot overcome feature ceiling. Negative but valuable result supporting "feature design is the contribution" narrative.
